progression.narrative: The performance opens on G4 and dwells most on D in Phrase 1. Phrase 3 (0:20.7) introduces A, Bb, Dk, centred on D. Phrase 8 (3:54.1) introduces C, centred on Bb. Phrase 14 (5:53.2) introduces Bk, centred on Bk. The line peaks at D5 (607.4 Hz) at 5:24.4. It closes on D4, not the tonic (D4 → D4 → G3 → G4 → D4 → D4).
